verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a commerce platform with a developer ecosystem, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents a BigCommerce CLI. The tools-and-SDKs page mentions API clients, the Checkout SDK and a design system, and the developer portal offers an in-browser Request Runner, none of which is a command-line tool. A community comment about running the site locally does not name a CLI and cannot be credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
